# TravelDoss

> Plan trips and see them on a live, day-by-day map. TravelDoss turns any pasted itinerary into a pinned, categorized, routed dossier microsite — viewable as a live URL, exportable as a PDF, and usable fully offline.

TravelDoss is a trip-planning tool. You pick a "skin" (an editorial dossier template), paste or write your trip, and TravelDoss extracts every place — lodging, food, sights, transport — and pins them on a live, routed map organized by day. Each trip lives at its own private URL for a month for $1, can be exported to PDF with clickable links, and stays available offline once opened.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What TravelDoss is and how it turns a pasted itinerary into a live map.
- [Skins](/templates): The gallery of editorial dossier designs to choose from.
